rules.description: Applicant must have completed Mandatory Reconsideration or have valid exemption
rules.reason_if_failed: You must request a Mandatory Reconsideration from DWP before appealing to the tribunal. Your decision letter will say if you can appeal without this.

rules.description: Appeal must be submitted within 1 month of Mandatory Reconsideration decision
rules.reason_if_failed: Appeals must be submitted within 1 month of your Mandatory Reconsideration decision. You can still submit a late appeal but must explain why it's late. It may not be accepted.

rules.description: The benefit decision must be one that can be appealed to this tribunal
rules.reason_if_failed: This benefit type cannot be appealed through this service. Check your decision letter for the correct appeals process.

rules.description: Applicant must provide National Insurance number
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a National Insurance number to submit an appeal

rules.description: Applicant must be in England, Wales or Scotland
rules.reason_if_failed: This tribunal is for England, Wales and Scotland only. Northern Ireland has a different process. Social Security Scotland decisions have a separate appeals process.

edge_cases.description: Appeal submitted more than 1 month after Mandatory Reconsideration decision
edge_cases.action: Accept appeal but flag for judicial review. Citizen must provide written explanation for delay. Tribunal will decide whether to accept the late appeal.

edge_cases.description: Appeal relates to Child Maintenance decision
edge_cases.action: Cannot appeal online. Direct citizen to SSCS2 postal form. Provide address for HMCTS Child Maintenance Appeals.

edge_cases.description: Appeal relates to HMRC decision (Tax Credits, Tax-Free Childcare)
edge_cases.detection: benefit_type in ['Tax Credits', 'Tax-Free Childcare', '30 hours free childcare']
edge_cases.action: Cannot appeal online. Direct citizen to SSCS5 postal form for HMRC appeals.

edge_cases.description: Appeal relates to Vaccine Damage Payment
edge_cases.action: Cannot appeal online. Direct citizen to SSCS7 postal form specifically for Vaccine Damage Payment appeals.

edge_cases.description: Citizen requires reasonable adjustments for hearing (interpreter, hearing loop, accessible room)
edge_cases.action: Flag case for tribunal accommodations. Document requirements in case file. HMCTS will arrange official interpreter - citizen cannot bring their own.

edge_cases.description: Citizen or representative is outside UK and wants to give live evidence
edge_cases.action: Citizen must contact tribunal as soon as possible to request video/audio link. Must specify country and type of evidence. Tribunal will assess feasibility.

edge_cases.description: Appellant has mental health condition or other vulnerability affecting capacity
edge_cases.action: Consider need for representative. Flag case for additional support. May require assessment of capacity to participate in hearing.
